Initial release - Query crypto wallet data using Zerion's MCP server.

Features:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - Portfolio analysis (multi-chain)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Transaction history                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  - DeFi positions 
  - Profit and Loss (PnL)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - Token prices & charts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - NFT collections                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  - Gas prices
